run.method: speech-first morphological minimal pairs: derivation, conversion, identity roles
run.brief: Create a schema_version 1 identity portfolio for a pre-release Elixir/OTP library for declared, callable, measurable, optimizable LM programs, with a credible artifact horizon spanning instructions, demonstrations, tool descriptions, retrieval policies, playbooks, schemas, code fragments, and configuration. Treat it as neither an official DSPy port, static proof system, universal agent OS, provider SDK, guaranteed autonomous self-improvement system, safety product, standards body, institute, nor universal platform. Generate exactly 30 preserved candidates in three ten-item cells: ordinals 1-10 derivation-clipping across declaration-contract and boundary-translation using coined-category-noun and ordinary-verb forms for Elixir newcomers, international users, and future maintainers; ordinals 11-20 conversion-grammar across action-agency and care-stewardship-repair using ordinary-verb, ordinary-object, and phrase-imperative forms for affected publics and backend product engineers; ordinals 21-30 identity-grammar across plurality-ecosystem and infrastructure-logistics using namespace-led, institutional-community, and descriptive-category forms for future maintainers, buyers-founders, and OSS contributors. Use speech-first minimal pairs across full stem, front and back clipping, elision, prefix, suffix, and conversion, distinguishing recoverability from mere brevity. Test noun, verb, adjective, command, participle, and unavailable readings in support calls and code. Give identity candidates complete truthful role systems for master, descriptor, library, research, community, company, protocol, and product family, marking unsupported roles unavailable. Every candidate must have non-null pronunciation and grammar, honest etymology or explicit coined/no-source text, nonempty valid audience and architecture lenses, rationale, concerns, and separate challenge_wave, challenge_cell, form_mechanism, stance, scope, code_projection, current_embodiment, and horizon_embodiment notes. Use exactly six wildcard candidates, two per cell; exactly five affirmative candidates per cell; cells 1 and 7 have three ambivalent and two adverse candidates, cell 4 has two ambivalent and three adverse candidates; and every cell has four current, four horizon, and two both scopes.
